affected_callers: GitHub Actions Verify Adam Development Habits workflow

acceptance_criteria.condition: The workflow uses checkout@v5 and setup-python@v6, whose official tags resolve on GitHub.
The workflow remains valid YAML and retains every verification step.
The next GitHub run has no Node 20 deprecation annotation from these actions.
acceptance_criteria.verification: GitHub Actions run for this commit

invariants: The workflow continues to run checkout, Python setup, dependency installation, evidence checks, full tests, causal replays, and diff validation.
The workflow uses officially resolved action tags that run on the current Node runtime.
Action runtime upgrades do not alter the Skill's runtime dependencies or behavior.

safeguards.name: current action runtimes
safeguards.rationale: checkout@v5 and setup-python@v6 replace the Node 20-targeting action majors that generated the GitHub annotation.

safeguards.name: workflow regression
safeguards.rationale: A package test verifies the required action majors remain explicit in the active workflow.

safeguards.name: unchanged verification surface
safeguards.rationale: Only action runtime versions change; all existing verification steps remain present and will rerun remotely.

design_boundary.rationale: The active workflow owns action runtime selection, while the evidence-script test owns regression detection for the chosen action majors.

dependency_audit.rationale: No Python or Skill dependency changes; this update changes only existing GitHub Action major tags.

extension_decision.rationale: The workflow retains its existing steps and adds no extension point or adapter.

data_ownership.rationale: No mutable business, personal, or application data is handled.

error_model.rationale: The remote warning is eliminated by replacing the responsible action runtime versions, while a future downgrade becomes a deterministic regression failure.

contract_evolution.rationale: No public API, schema, or consumer contract changes.

operational_budget.rationale: The action runtime upgrade does not add an application runtime, latency, or resource budget.

threat_boundary.rationale: No secrets, authentication flow, untrusted input, or privileged application operation changes.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The two action upgrades, regression test, evidence record, local checks, and GitHub verification are delivered as one atomic update.

release_recovery.rationale: No deployable service release; one commit reverts the runtime tags if GitHub compatibility regresses.

data_migration.rationale: No schema, backfill, persistence, or data transformation changes.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The workflow permissions, inputs, and secret boundaries are unchanged.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: The official checkout and setup-python actions are upgraded only after their v5 and v6 tags resolved through the GitHub API; no third-party action is introduced.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The evidence records the original Node 20 annotation, resolved official tag objects, and the reason the runtime majors are pinned by regression test.

reproducibility.rationale: The workflow text, official action tag object IDs, exact commands, timestamp, revision, and captured output are retained.

verification.result: 57 evidence and workflow contract tests passed.
All pre-existing evidence artifacts validated before this update artifact was added.

supporting_artifacts.summary: The workflow action-runtime contract test passed.
All stored evidence present before this artifact validated.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert this atomic update if the new official action majors fail in GitHub; do not restore the deprecated Node 20 versions merely to bypass a test failure.
remaining_risks: GitHub controls action implementation behind tags; the next workflow run is required to confirm the runtime warning is absent.
Future GitHub Action runtime deprecations may require a similarly reviewed action-major upgrade.
